    The Texas Rangers vs. Philadelphia Phillies game on Saturday, March 28, 2026, at 4:05 p.m. ET (3:05 p.m. CT) can be watched on
    NBC Sports Philadelphia+ and the Rangers Sports Network. Streaming options include Fubo (free trial available), MLB.TV for out-of-market viewers, and Victory+. 
    TV Channels & Streaming Services 
    • Phillies Region: NBC Sports Philadelphia+ (NBCSP+).
    • Rangers Region: Rangers Sports Network.
    • Streaming Options: Fubo TV (includes regional sports networks), MLB.TV (out-of-market), and Victory+ (in-market for Rangers).
    • Alternative Streaming: Peacock. 
    Key Details 
    • Date: Saturday, March 28, 2026.
    • Time: 4:05 PM ET / 3:05 PM CT.
    • Venue: Citizens Bank Park, Philadelphia, PA. 
    Note: In-market streaming for the Rangers is available via the Victory+ app or Fubo.
